items.name: CubingUSA Great Lakes Championship 2025
items.information: ![GLC 2025 Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA4ODgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--06655aacf63e94a0dc9e3368eb27d87f34b64986/Asset%2027@4x.png) ![Partnered organizations logos](https://i.imgur.com/ghYzBXw.png) This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* and *[CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2025. Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.

items.name: Minerva Zapopan 2025

venue.name: Unidad Administrativa Basílica
venue.address: Prol. 20 De Noviembre s/n, Zapopan, 45100 Zapopan, Jal.
venue.details: Entrando hacia la derecha, salones 2 y 3.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwNDIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3d0f200f119dfe710ff0ad68c98d92199cc29b4f/1000441019.png) **¡Bienvenidos a la competencia más grande de Jalisco!** La Minerva está de vuelta, pero esta vez con más fuerza que nunca. La segunda competencia en Zapopan y la décimo séptima en Jalisco, con tres días de competencia y todas las categorías oficiales de la WCA. ¡Los invitamos a disfrutar del centro de Zapopan, la ciudad de las niñas y los niños! Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia. **Welcome to the biggest competition in Jalisco!** La Minerva is back, but this time stronger than ever. The second competition in Zapopan and the seventeenth in Jalisco, featuring three days of competition and all official WCA events. We invite you to enjoy downtown Zapopan, the city of girls and boys! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

items.name: CubingUSA New England Championship 2025
items.information: We are pleased to announce the 2025 CubingUSA New England Championship! This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjI1MTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--91e6ff49dd858ef5ca2d73c0cfcd6269eb7deb89/NEC2025-Logo.png)

venue.name: Heiahallen
venue.details: Idrettshallen - Go anticlockwise around the building to find the entrance

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE0MDI2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--796bec32f0666d29384682342b18ff943a53d2ee/NMLogo.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2025, denne gangen hold i Lierskogen. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2025, held in Lierskogen. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.
